Freeport Vendors

Listed here are the Freeport vendors. So far all that is listed is the general vendors and a few of the enchanter vendors. The building is set up with four different levels. On the ground level where you enter, you will find the General vendor. On the bottom level is the Enchanter vendors. I have not confirmed this yet, but I believe that the magicians vendors are on the first floor and the wizard vendors are on the second floor. The Necromnacer vendors can be found the the sewer section of the city.
